Calculate egg production

Source: R/core_model_production.R
calc_egg_production.Rd

Calculates food-egg outputs for chickens over the assessment period.

Usage

calc_egg_production(
  species_short,
  cohort_short,
  egg_human_consumption_yield,
  egg_average_weight,
  simulation_duration,
  cohort_stock_size,
  egg_protein_fraction = 0.125,
  nondemo_productive_phase_id = NA_real_,
  is_egg_producing = FALSE
)

Arguments

species_short

Character. Code identifying the livestock species. Supported values include:

  • CHK: chickens

cohort_short

Character. Sex- and age-specific cohort code describing the production stage of the animals. Supported values include:

  • FA: adult females (from age at first parturition)

  • FS: sub-adult females (from weaning to age at first parturition)

  • FJ: juvenile females (from birth to weaning)

  • FN: non-demographic females

  • MA: adult males (from age at first breeding)

  • MS: sub-adult males (from weaning to age at first breeding)

  • MJ: juvenile males (from birth to weaning)

  • MN: non-demographic males

egg_human_consumption_yield

Numeric. Number of eggs produced for human consumption in one year by hen (eggs/year/animal). Used for CHK.

egg_average_weight

Numeric. Average egg weight (kg/egg).

simulation_duration

Numeric. Length of the assessment period (days).

cohort_stock_size

Numeric. Average population size of the assessed cohort (heads).

egg_protein_fraction

Numeric. Protein content of whole egg (kg protein/kg egg).

nondemo_productive_phase_id

Numeric. Optional productive phase identifier for non-demographic cohorts.

is_egg_producing

Logical. Cohort-level flag identifying food-egg-producing CHK cohorts. This can be TRUE only for FA and for FN with nondemo_productive_phase_id = 2.

Value

A named list with total egg number, mass, and protein over the assessment period.

Details

Food-egg production is computed only for cohorts flagged with is_egg_producing = TRUE. Validation restricts this flag to demographic laying hens (FA) and to non-demographic FN phase 2 when intensive layers are represented in the non-demographic pathway. Reproductive eggs from FA are excluded from these food outputs.

The following equations are applied:

$$ egg\_production\_number\_cohort = \frac{egg\_human\_consumption\_yield}{365} \times cohort\_stock\_size \times simulation\_duration $$

$$ egg\_production\_mass\_cohort = egg\_production\_number\_cohort \times egg\_average\_weight $$

$$ egg\_production\_protein\_cohort = egg\_production\_mass\_cohort \times egg\_protein\_fraction $$

where the default egg_protein_fraction is 0.125 kg protein/kg egg mass, following the poultry integration assumptions used in GLEAM-X.

References

Caffa, I., Proietti, E., Turrini, F., Borgarelli, C., Ferrando, M. R., Formisano, E., ... & Pisciotta, L. (2025). Nutritional Aspects of Eggs for a Healthy and Sustainable Consumption: A Narrative Review. Food Science & Nutrition, 13(9), e70285.
